scripts.dev: bun run --cwd package build && bun run --cwd app dev
scripts.start:ci: bun run build && bun run --cwd app preview --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3000
scripts.build: bun run --cwd package lint && bun run --cwd package build && bun run --cwd app build
scripts.deploy: bun run --cwd package lint && bun run --cwd package build && IS_DEPLOYMENT=true bun run --cwd app build
scripts.cover: bun run --cwd package build && vitest run --coverage --project package
scripts.lint: biome check . && bun run typecheck && bun run knip
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd package build && bun run --workspaces typecheck
scripts.test: bun run --cwd package build && vitest run
scripts.release: bun run test && bun run --cwd package check:package && changeset publish
